title: Detention of public library materials; penalty.
bodyText:
(a) A person who detains any public library materials belonging to any community, school, or public library for one day after the due date of the public library materials, shall be subject to a nominal charge established by the board of education.

(b) A person detaining any public library materials thirty days or more after the due date of the materials shall be subject to a charge commensurate with the replacement value of the public library materials.
bodyHtml:
§312-3.5  Detention of public library materials; penalty.  (a)  A person who detains any public library materials belonging to any community, school, or public library for one day after the due date of the public library materials, shall be subject to a nominal charge established by the board of education.

     (b)  A person detaining any public library materials thirty days or more after the due date of the materials shall be subject to a charge commensurate with the replacement value of the public library materials. [L 1979, c 117, §1; am L 1981, c 150, §9; am L 1983, c 134, §1; am L 1991, c 145, §2; am L 2018, c 171, §2]
